content: “Di řweqt nni, ammu i iqqar SIDI, ad iřiɣ d AREBBI i marra řaǧat n Israil u nitni ad iřin d řgens inu.”
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Řgens n yinni inejmen zi ssif, yufa arḍa di řexřa, ejj ayi ad raḥeɣ Necc maḥend ad t ssareyyḥeɣ, wah, maḥend ad ssareyyḥeɣ Israil!’”
“Zi řaggʷaj iban ayi-dd SIDI!” ...
“Necc tuɣa ttexseɣ cem s tayri n řebda, x uya cem dd-jebdeɣ s tmexsiwt icewwaren.
Necc ad cem bniɣ ɛawed, ad tᵉttwabnid ɛawed, a cem Israil taɛzarect. Cem ad tzewwqed ixef nnem ɛawed s ibendiren, ad teffɣed s ccḍiḥ s nnubtat n yinni ifarrḥen.
Ad teẓẓud tizayarin deg imarjaɛen x idurar n Samarya: inni itteẓẓun ad tent ẓẓun u řɣiǧet ad zzayes arren meẓri.
Maɣar ad dd-yas wass nni di ad řaɣan iɛessasen x idurar n Ifrayim: ‘Kkarem, ejj aneɣ ad ngeɛɛed ɣar Ṣihyun, ɣar SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ!’”
“Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Ɣennjem s řefraḥet i Yaɛqub, sřiwřiwem i uzeǧif n řegnus, barrḥem, semɣarem t, inim: A SIDI, senjem řgens nnec, min iqqimen zi Israil.

Xzar, Necc ad ten arreɣ ad dd-asen zi temmurt n ccamal u Necc ad ten ssmuneɣ zeg ineggura n temmurt. Aqa din jar asen idarɣařen d ineɛḍaben, tinni iǧan s ddeyset d tinni ittarwen. Ad ɛeqben ɣar da s ijj n wegraw n řgens ameqqran.
Ad dd-asen ttrun, ad ten gewwdeɣ am kessin s řmeɛruf. Ad ten ssnedheɣ ɣar teɣzarin n waman, x ijj n webrid iseggmen mani war ttneqriḍen, maɣar Necc d Babas i Israil u Ifrayim d mmi amenzu.’”
“Sřem i wawař n SIDI, a kenniw řegnus, barrḥem t x tegzirin nni iggʷejen aṭṭas, inim: ‘D wenni tuɣa izzuzaren Israil, ad t issmun ɛawed u ad t yarwes am mammec yarekkwes umeksaw taḥimart nnes.
Maɣar SIDI aqa ifdi Yaɛqub uca ifekk i-t zeg ufus n wenni xas ijehden.’

Nitni ad dd-asen u ad sřiwřewen x řgeɛɛdet n Ṣihyun uca ad azzřen ɣar řxar n SIDI, ɣar imendi, ɣar binu n jdid, ɣar zzect, ɣar izmaren u ɣar ifunasen d tfunasin. Řeɛmar nsen ad yiři am řeɛraṣi ittwassun uca ɛemmarṣ ɛad ad iřin ceḍnen.
Xenni ad tfarḥ teɛzarect ɣar ccḍiḥ s nnubtat, uřa d iḥudriyyen d iwessura, nitni marra munen, minzi Necc ad arreɣ acḍan nsen d arcuq, ad ten ɛezziɣ, ad ten ssfarḥeɣ awarni wecḍan nsen.
Necc ad ssjiwneɣ řeɛmar n ikehhanen s tadunt n tɣarṣa uca ad idweř řgens inu ijjiwen s řxar inu, ammu i iqqar SIDI.”
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Tᵉttwaseř ict n tmijja di Rama, aweɛɛed d imeṭṭawen imarzagen: Raḥil tᵉttru x tarwa nnes u war tᵉttexs ad tᵉttwaɛezza x iḥenjiren nnes, maɣar nitni war ǧin ɛad.’
Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Ṭṭef tmijja nnem i unixses u tiṭṭawin nnem i imeṭṭawen, maɣar aqa teǧa řmunet i warber nnem, ammu i iqqar SIDI, maɣar nitni ad dd-ɛeqben zi temmurt n řeɛdu.
Aqa din řayas i tarwa nnem, ammu i iqqar SIDI, maɣar iḥenjiren nnem ad dd-dewřen ɣar temmurt nsen.’”
“Necc sřiɣ mliḥ mammec dd-ittcetca Ifrayim, inna: ‘Cek tarebbid ayi u necc ttwarebbiɣ am yijj n uɛejmi war ittḍawaɛen. Arr ayi, deɣya necc xseɣ ad dd-dewřeɣ, maɣar Cek d SIDI, AREBBI inu.
Maɣar awarni řami dd-dewřeɣ, tubeɣ, u awarni řami dewřeɣ ssneɣ, wtiɣ ixef inu x tmeṣṣaḍin. Necc seḍḥiɣ, nfeḍḥeɣ, maɣar necc arbuɣ řefḍiḥet n temẓi inu.’

Ma war iǧi Ifrayim d mmi iɣřan ɣari d aḥenjir inu iɛizzen? Maɣar kuř ict n twařa ssiwřeɣ ɣares s ufus n inabiyyen, qqimeɣ ttidareɣ t. X uya iccat jjuf inu dayi. Nican Necc ad xas arreḥmeɣ, ammu i iqqar SIDI.”
“Sbedd iquǧay i wescan n webrid, sars iẓra n jjurrat n webrid, egg uř nnem x webrid iseggmen, x webrid nni di teggured. Dweř, a taɛzarect Israil, dweř ɣar tneddam nnem.
Ař meřmi ɛad texsed ad teqqimed tᵉttliɛed, a cem, yeǧis i xafi iḥeyyden? Maɣar SIDI igga ict n řḥajjet n jdid di temmurt: Tamɣart ad tᵉtthilla marra i weryaz.”

“Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Ad ssiwřen awař-a ɛawed di temmurt n Yahuda u di tneddam nnes xmi ɣa ssenqeřbeɣ tameḥbast nsen: Ad cem ibarek SIDI, a Tazeddiɣt n tsegda, a adrar iqeddsen!
Yahuda d marra tineddam nnes ad dayes zeddɣent jmiɛ, ifeǧaḥen d yinni ittetliɛen ak-d tḥimart.
Maɣar Necc ssessuɣ řeɛmar yuḥřen uca ssjiwneɣ kuř řeɛmar iḥzen.’”
Awarni aya faqeɣ-dd uca uciɣ mecḥar yiziḍ yiḍeṣ inu.
“Xzar, ad dd-asen wussan, ammu i iqqar SIDI, ad zarɛeɣ taddart n Israil d taddart n Yahuda s zzarriɛet n iwdan d řmař.
Am mammec xasen ɛesseɣ ḥima ad qeřɛeɣ, ad hedmeɣ, ad arẓeɣ, ad areddǧeɣ u ad ggeɣ řɣar, ammu i xasen i ɣa ɛesseɣ ḥima ad ssbeddeɣ u ḥima ad ẓẓuɣ, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
Deg wussan nni war ttɣimin ad inin ɛad: ‘Ibabaten ccin aḍiř asemmam uca dewřent teɣmas n iḥenjiren ḥfant.’
Maca kuř ijj ad immet zi ssibbet n řmuɛṣiyyet n yixef nnes. Zi mkuř bnadem nni i ɣa iccen aḍir asemmam, ad as dewřent teɣmas ḥfant.”
“Xzar, ad dd-asen wussan, ammu i iqqar SIDI, nni di ɣa ggeɣ ijj n Řɛahd n Jdid ak-d taddart n Israil u ak-d taddart n Yahuda,
war iǧi am mammec Řɛahd i ggiɣ ak-d řejdud nsen umi ten ṭṭfeɣ zeg ufus, ḥima ad ten nedheɣ zi temmurt n Miṣra, Řɛahd inu nni arẓin, waxxa zeɛma Necc dewřeɣ d Aryaz nsen, ammu i iqqar SIDI.

Maɣar wa ad yiři d Řɛahd nni i ɣa ggeɣ awarni i wussan nni ak-d taddart n Israil, ammu i iqqar SIDI: Necc ad ggeɣ Ccariɛa inu deg wuř nsen uca ad tt ariɣ deg wuř nsen. Necc ad iřiɣ d SIDI i nitni u nitni ad iřin d řgens i Necc.

Uřa d ijjen war isseřmid ɛad jjar nnes niɣ umas, am qqaren: ‘Ssen SIDI!’, maɣar nitni marra ad ayi ssnen, am umeẓyan am umeqqran jar asen, ammu i iqqar SIDI, maɣar Necc ad asen ɣfareɣ i řmuɛṣiyyet nsen u war ttidareɣ ɛad ddnub nsen.”
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI, wenni iggin tfuct i tfawt deg wass, wenni yumuren taziri d itran i tfawt di ǧiřet, wenni issehwařen řebḥar ařami dd-duqquzent řemwaj nnes, aqa SIDI n řɛeskarat d Isem nnes:
‘Mařa lfarayiḍ-a ad dd-wḍant zeg wudem inu, iqqar SIDI, xenni ad ibedd uřa d zzariɛet n Israil ad tiři d ijj n řgens zzat i wudem inu, marra ussan.’
Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Mařa ttwaɛbaren ijenwan sennej u mařa zemmaren ad arzun sadu dsusa n temmurt, xenni uřa d Necc ad nḍareɣ zzariɛet n Israil zi ssibbet n marra min ggin, ammu i iqqar SIDI.’”
“Xzar, ammu i iqqar SIDI, ad dd-asen wussan nni di ɣa bnan tandint ɛawed i SIDI, zi Ṣṣumɛet n Ḥananiyil ař Tewwart n Teɣmart,
uca ad iffeɣ ufiřu n řeqyas ɛad ktar, nican ɣar zzat ɣar tewrirt n Jarib uca xenni ad imeyyeř ɣar Juɛa.

Marra taysart s řxecbat immuten u s yiɣɣeḍ d marra iyyaren ař teɣzart n Qidrun ař teɣmart n Tewwart n Yeysan ɣar ccarq, marra aya ad yiři d amqeddas i SIDI. Ɛemmarṣ ad tᵉttwaqřeɛ u ad tᵉttwahdem uřa d ict n řḥajjet ɛad i řebda.”

footnotes.text: ifekk- s lḥarf ‘ad ifdi’. Xzar Izhd. 78:35.
